title: SvgSvg
responsibility: Renders the native svg element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgSvg.attributes
inputs.description: Native svg attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgSvg.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native svg element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgSvg
outputs.description: The actual native svg element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
